ai_summary_en: [Gemini Vision + 3D Trunk Cylinder & Ground Photo Referee] Multi-scale local DTM, strict 3D trunk cylinder slicing ('No Trunk = No Tree'), and 50 calibrated mobile phone photo projection(s) on 'catch_DaAn' verified 1 paved road & walkway corridor(s) (81.9 m² planar, excluding turf lawns & tree planters), 49 trunk-verified urban & park tree(s) (mean 1.3m breast-height DBH 25.4 cm via anti-webbing Pratt circle fit), 0 water bodies (dry urban/campus/park terrain), and 4 retaining/structural wall segment(s) (344.0 m² true 3D vertical face area).
